title: Packaging Service Materials & Methods Used in Addis Moves
excerpt: Blankets, stretch wrap, dish packs, and wardrobe boxes—what full pack includes vs owner-packed fragile risk.
content:
What professional packing includes

Active Movers packaging service separates materials from labor on your quote so you know what you are paying for. Full-home pack is common before long legs to Bishoftu, Adama, or Hawassa; partial pack (kitchen + fragile only) suits renters leaving a furnished condo.

Materials we use on Addis streets

  • Moving blankets — quilted wraps on sofas, tables, and headboards for cobblestone shock.
  • Stretch wrap — secures drawers and keeps blanket bundles tight in the truck.
  • Dish packs & cell dividers — for glass, ceramics, and small appliances.
  • Wardrobe boxes — hang clothes without re-folding; popular for Kazanchis and Bole professionals.
  • Double-walled cartons — for books and electronics when original OEM boxes are missing.

Owner-packed vs mover-packed risk

When you pack fragile items yourself, damage claims are harder to document. Mover-packed cartons are labeled, photographed at load, and tied to crew accountability—see fragile electronics guide. If you mix owner and pro pack, mark each box clearly on the inventory.

Partial pack scenarios

Kitchen-only packs before move-out handover save time on cleaning day. Office file packs use numbered cartons matched to desk plans—pair with office downtime checklist.

Pricing and booking

Packing hours stack on top of baseline move tiers on the 2026 cost guide and homepage pricing. Survey captures room count, fragile density, and whether management requires floor protection in lifts.

Labeling and inventory

Each carton should list room and contents on two sides. Movers photograph high-value items at load when declared value matters. For electronics, note serial numbers on the inventory sheet—helps if a screen arrives with new damage after a cobblestone leg.

Stairs and elevators

Pack heavy books in small cartons—movers carry them through freight lifts in Bole and Ayat towers. Floor protection in lifts may be required; ask management before tape or masonite goes down. Combine packing day with survey so materials count matches room list.
